translations.web: I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and animal. They will die of a great pestilence.
translations.bsb: I will strike down the residents of this city, both man and beast. They will die in a terrible plague.’
translations.kjv: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.
